title: Two US soldiers and interpreter killed by IS gunman in Syria, US military says
summary: Three other service members were injured in the attack, during which the gunman was "engaged and killed", according to the US military.

title: Pulp Fiction actor Peter Greene found dead in New York apartment
summary: Greene, 60, praised for the various villains he played during his career but manager says he also had ‘heart as big as gold’ Peter Greene, the actor known for his roles in Pulp Fiction and The Mask, has died at the age of 60. He was found dead at his New York City apartment on Friday, his manager said, and the cause of death has not been disclosed. Continue reading...
